page.layout: Book cover and spine only: marbled boards, with a spine carrying partly visible gold-tooled lettering and a small paper label at the lower edge. No printed text page.
page.notes: Front cover of a bound volume, marbled paper boards in purple and brown, photographed without a text block. The spine has gold-tooled lettering, but it is cut off at the edge of the scan and cannot be read with any certainty, so it is not transcribed. A small paper label near the foot of the spine is also partly visible and unreadable. Neither is a printed page of the book, and both are left out of the main text.
